review_context.commercial_perspective: Upgraded from a v1 gold set.
review_context.objective: Pre-signature review of a vendor paper contract for a business-critical system.

comment: CANDIDATE, NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Offsets derived from v1 anchors; severities carried over from a single annotator. Requires blind second annotation and adjudication before replacing expected/*.json.

obligations.label: Service Levels
obligations.quote: commercially reasonable efforts to maintain 99.5% monthly

obligations.label: Data Protection
obligations.quote: process Customer Personal Data only on documented instructions

obligations.label: Limitation Of Liability
obligations.quote: shall not exceed the fees paid

risk.rationale: medium — a twelve month fee cap is common market practice, but it carves out nothing for data breach, confidentiality or IP indemnity, which is worse than market and should be negotiated.

obligations.label: Term
obligations.quote: initial term of this Agreement is twelve (12) months

obligations.label: Auto Renewal
obligations.quote: renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms

risk.rationale: high — a ninety day notice window against a twelve month term means the decision point falls at month nine, and a single missed date commits the customer to another full year.

obligations.label: Subprocessors
obligations.quote: may appoint sub-processors to process Customer Personal Data

risk.rationale: high — appointing sub-processors with website publication and no notice gives the customer no opportunity to object and does not meet Art. 28(2) GDPR, which the data protection clause purports to comply with.

obligations.label: Security
obligations.quote:
industry standard security measures appropriate to a
provider

risk.rationale: medium — 'industry standard measures appropriate to a provider of its size' is unmeasurable and gives the customer nothing to audit against, but it is a drafting weakness rather than an absent obligation.

high — a perpetual irrevocable licence to train models on Customer Data expressly including Customer Personal Data has no lawful basis under the data protection clause in section 2, which limits processing to documented instructions. The two clauses contradict each other, and this one would make the provider a controller for that processing.

obligations.label: Indemnity
obligations.quote: indemnify and hold harmless the Provider

risk.rationale: high — the customer indemnifying the provider against third-party claims that the provider's own service infringes reverses the normal allocation. The party that built the service and can clear the rights bears none of the risk.

obligations.label: Fees
obligations.quote: may increase the fees at any time on thirty (30) days written notice

risk.rationale: high — an uncapped increase at any time on thirty days notice with no corresponding termination right is a unilateral right to reprice a locked-in customer.

obligations.label: Data Export On Termination
obligations.quote: delete all Customer Data seven (7) days after termination

risk.rationale: medium — a seven day deletion window with export only on request risks irreversible data loss on a missed deadline; thirty days with a standing export right is the ordinary position.
